description: Two-seat matches between external agents on the frozen match scenario: mirror matches first, every cross matchup played twice per seed with seats swapped.

pairing.rule: A mirror matchup (a participant against a fresh instance of itself) is played once per seed with the participant in both seats. A cross matchup is played twice per seed: side 1 puts the first participant in seat 1, side 2 swaps the seats. Both sides of a seed form one seed pair for the analysis.

scheduling.observations: Both seats observe the same completed turn.
scheduling.collection: Controllers decide concurrently under one shared wall-clock deadline while simulated time is paused; no seat can inspect the other's uncommitted actions.
scheduling.commit: Batches are committed together and applied in ascending seat order, preserving order within a seat; the order in which controllers finish is recorded as arrival_rank and never affects command timing.

timeout_policy.budget_exhaustion: budget stop: the seat resigns and the outcome is administrative
timeout_policy.provider_failure: infrastructure: bounded retries within the deadline; never counted toward a forfeit

result_rules.in_game: won = win, defeated = loss, turn limit = draw for both seats
result_rules.administrative: a forfeit or budget stop is an administrative loss and the surviving seat an administrative win; forfeits at the same decision are an administrative draw for both
result_rules.invalid: engine or runner failures and truncated traces are invalid runs, retried within the bounded policy and reported, never a defeat

analysis.outcomes: wins, draws, losses per participant, by side and per matchup, with administrative outcomes counted separately
analysis.match_score: (wins + 0.5 * draws) / valid matches per participant per matchup
analysis.uncertainty: percentile bootstrap of the match score, 2000 resamples, clustered by seed pair
analysis.rating: none: outcomes are published by side and matchup before any rating system
